composition: keep the human and AI subjects visible
one dominant visual idea per asset
calm blue-violet environment with restrained warm accents
leave breathing room around the main subject
support the story rather than replacing the README explanation
text_policy: Every narrative raster asset carries one exact short title plus one exact short subtitle; SVGs, logos, and tiny helper graphics stay text-free.
reject_when: the supporting diagram covers or competes with the human/AI subjects
the title or subtitle is unreadable
the image contains many competing panels or unreadable secondary text
contrast becomes more important than comprehension
the asset reads like a second hero banner instead of a supporting explanation
the crop removes the central relationship at mobile or tablet sizes
